name: valid_layout
about: Atoms only: a flex with a heading and text.

name: valid_product_card
about: product-card with catalog ids; the server fills name/price/image.

name: valid_emit_add_to_cart
about: A button whose click emits add_to_cart.

name: valid_emit_checkout
about: A button whose click emits checkout.

name: valid_local_state
about: Local state: a toggle bound to a state seed.

name: valid_form
about: A form widget for a gated verb.

name: at_char_limit
about: Exactly 32,000 characters: inside the bound.

name: over_char_limit
about: 32,001 characters: over the bound.

name: at_node_limit
about: 80 nodes: a flex with 79 text children.

name: over_node_limit
about: 81 nodes: a flex with 80 text children.

name: at_depth_limit
about: Nested 8 deep (the root is depth 1).

name: over_depth_limit
about: Nested 9 deep.

name: unknown_type
about: A type the bar has no widget for.

name: bad_action_navigate
about: navigate is not an action the bar honours.

name: bad_emit_target
about: emit to a host event other than add_to_cart / checkout.

name: children_not_list
about: children must be a list.

name: node_without_type
about: Every node needs a string type.

name: ui_not_object
about: ui must be a node object.

name: state_not_object
about: state, when present, must be an object.

name: legacy_product
about: A legacy {kind: product} card: no ui key.

name: legacy_form
about: A legacy {kind: form} card.

name: not_json
about: Not JSON at all: the legacy path's fallback.
